jobs.title: Fraud Analyst Officer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Fraud Analyst Officer to join our Middle Office – Anti-Fraud & Financial Crime Center team. The successful candidate will have excellent communication and organizational skills and an acute sense of attention to detail.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Effectively communicate with our internal customer support team in order to resolve dispute requests.

• Process dispute related transactions in the respective internal and card scheme systems (Visa and MasterCard platforms).

• Review of card transaction monitoring alerts to flag or identify suspicious activity outside the normal pattern and activity.

• Investigate and take immediate action on alerts, notifications and reporting to always ensure compliance.

• Resolve issues on behalf of card holders in support of dispute resolution processing, compare alternative actions and decide on appropriate approach.

• Respond to requests in relation to transactions.

• Maintain all investigation records and case outcomes.

• Develop and maintain strong working knowledge of all relevant card scheme rules and regulations.

• Explore new ways that can help improve existing fraud strategies.

• Continuously learning and improving on product and job knowledge.

• Minimum of 3 years’ experience in banking operations department.

• Knowledge of Visa and MasterCard dispute rules and regulations is highly preferred and will be considered a strong asset.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal in English and French.

• Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Strong analytical abilities.

• Capability to think out of the box.

• Able to work within a team.

• Able to manage stress and work with high volumes.

SQ1

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stiamo cercando un agente analista della Fraud per unirsi al nostro Middle Office – Anti-Fraud & Financial Crime Center team. Il candidato di successo avrà eccellenti capacità comunicative e organizzative e un senso acuto di attenzione ai dettagli. RISPOSIZIONI
• Efficacemente comunicare con il nostro team di assistenza clienti interno al fine di risolvere le richieste di controversie.
• Le operazioni relative alle controversie di processo nei rispettivi sistemi di schema interno e carta (piattaforme Visa e MasterCard).
• Recensione degli avvisi di monitoraggio delle transazioni della carta per contrassegnare o identificare attività sospette al di fuori del normale modello e attività.
• Indagare e intraprendere azioni immediate su avvisi, notifiche e report per garantire sempre la conformità.
• Risolvere le questioni per conto dei titolari di carte a sostegno del trattamento di risoluzione delle controversie, confrontare le azioni alternative e decidere su un approccio appropriato.
• Risponde alle richieste in relazione alle transazioni.
• Mantenere tutti i record di indagine e i risultati dei casi.
• Sviluppare e mantenere una forte conoscenza di lavoro di tutte le regole e regolamenti relativi del sistema di carte.
• Esplora nuovi modi che possono aiutare a migliorare le strategie di frode esistenti.
• L'apprendimento continuo e il miglioramento della conoscenza del prodotto e del lavoro.
• Esperienza minima di 3 anni nel reparto operazioni bancarie.
• La conoscenza delle regole e dei regolamenti di controversia Visa e MasterCard è altamente preferito e sarà considerato un bene forte.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, sia scritta che verbale in inglese e francese.
• Competenze organizzative eccezionali e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Forte capacità analitiche.
• Capacità di pensare fuori dalla scatola.
• In grado di lavorare in una squadra.
• In grado di gestire lo stress e lavorare con volumi elevati. SQ1

• Tenir à jour tous les dossiers d'enquête et les résultats des dossiers.
• Développer et maintenir une solide connaissance pratique de toutes les règles et réglementations relatives aux systèmes de cartes.
• Explorer de nouvelles façons d'améliorer les stratégies de fraude existantes.
• Apprentissage continu et amélioration des connaissances sur les produits et les emplois.
• Minimum de 3 ans d'expérience dans le département des opérations bancaires.
• La connaissance des règles et des règlements relatifs aux différends relatifs aux visas et aux cartes MasterCard est hautement privilégiée et sera considérée comme un atout important.

• Compétences organisationnelles exceptionnelles et attention aux détails.
• Fortes capacités d'analyse.
• Capacité de penser hors de la boîte.
• Peut travailler au sein d'une équipe.
• Capable de gérer le stress et de travailler avec des volumes élevés. QS1

jobs.title: Product Owner - Institutional & Wealth
jobs.description:
Department Mission - Software Engineering Platforms
 The Software Engineering Platforms department is dedicated to the customer's journey in Swissquote. We define, analyze and make alive the future of client facing solutions offered by Swissquote. We also maintain those applications to always ensure the best client experience in his journey.
 By collaborating closely with product strategy department we also are the bridge between company’s growth strategy and the corresponding solutions put in place, being then the core actors giving concrete life to the vision defined.
 By working hand in hand with the internal departments and the business that they represent we ensure to always move towards clients and stakeholders needs.

Team Mission
 The Institutional and Wealth section designs, develops and maintains passive investment platforms on Web and mobile for retail clients (InvestEasy, 3a easy, Save Easy, and more to come) as well as the whole set of solutions for institutional clients (APIs, SQPro platform, bridges with FX external platforms…)
 You will be part of Institutional and Wealth Conception team , working together with 3 other product owners, a product designer and an offshore business analyst.

The mission of the team is to transform company strategy into feasible solutions and drive the product's evolution together with the software engineering teams. Your team is focusing on all aspects related to Institutional business and Wealth management across all business lines (Forex, securities, crypto).
 Your responsibilities:

• Communicate and manage relationships with stakeholders to deliver the best product

• Define and document business requirements to capture business needs and constraints, and guide the development process

• Define and maintain a product roadmap to provide a clear direction to the Development teams and stakeholders

• Prioritize the product backlog to ensure that the most valuable work is addressed first and maximize ROI

• Analyze and prioritize client feedback for driving continuous improvements and meeting user expectations

• Collaborate with designers to optimize the user experience (e.g A/B testing, mobile & web)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert for the product, support business and development teams by knowledge sharing and mentoring

• Maintain awareness of market and industry trends for better optimization of solution definition

• Provide guidance on the vision to the Development Team and explain requirements

• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for business feature references

• Monitor KPIs to perform feature prioritization and enhance data-driven decisions

• Ensure incremental business validation to make sure developed features meet business requirements

• Educational background: Master or Bachelor degree

• You have a deep understanding of securities trading, forex trading a plus

• You have several years of experience as product owner, business analyst or a similar role

• You have several years of experience working with agile software development teams, and a good understanding of product development in a disciplined agile environment

• You have experience working closely with product designers to build end client solutions on web platforms, mobile a plus

• You have a thorough understanding of the product quality aspect, with prior experience of planning and coordinating business validation activities

• You are an excellent communicator and storyteller with different stakeholders, able to face stakeholders as well institutional clients

• You have experience in sharing your business knowledge and mentoring other team members

• Fluent in English

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione del Dipartimento - Piattaforme di Ingegneria del Software Il reparto Piattaforme di Ingegneria Software è dedicato al viaggio del cliente in Swissquote. Definiamo, analizziamo e realizziamo il futuro delle soluzioni di cliente offerte da Swissquote. Manteniamo anche quelle applicazioni per garantire sempre la migliore esperienza del cliente nel suo viaggio. Collaborando a stretto contatto con il reparto strategia di prodotto siamo anche il ponte tra la strategia di crescita dell’azienda e le soluzioni corrispondenti messe in atto, essendo poi i protagonisti che danno vita concreta alla visione definita. Lavorando fianco a fianco con i dipartimenti interni e il business che essi rappresentano ci assicuriamo di muoversi sempre verso i clienti e le esigenze degli stakeholder. Missione La sezione Istituzionale e Wealth progetta, sviluppa e mantiene piattaforme di investimento passive su Web e mobile per i clienti retail (InvestEasy, 3a easy, Save Easy, and more to come) così come l'intera serie di soluzioni per i clienti istituzionali (piattaforma API, SQPro, ponti con piattaforme esterne FX...) Sarete parte del team Istituzionale e Wealth Conception , lavorando insieme con altri 3 proprietari di prodotti, un product designer e un analista di business offshore. La missione del team è di trasformare la strategia aziendale in soluzioni possibili e guidare l'evoluzione del prodotto insieme ai team di ingegneria del software. Il vostro team si sta concentrando su tutti gli aspetti relativi al business istituzionale e alla gestione della ricchezza in tutte le linee aziendali (Forex, titoli, crypto). Le tue responsabilità:
• Comunicare e gestire le relazioni con gli stakeholder per fornire il miglior prodotto
• Definire e documentare i requisiti aziendali per catturare le esigenze e i vincoli aziendali e guidare il processo di sviluppo
• Definire e mantenere una roadmap del prodotto per fornire una chiara direzione per i team di sviluppo e le parti interessate
• Priorizzare il backlog del prodotto per garantire che il lavoro più prezioso sia affrontato prima e massimizzare ROI
• Analizzare e privilegiare il feedback dei clienti per la guida di miglioramenti continui e soddisfare le aspettative degli utenti
• Collabora con i progettisti per ottimizzare l'esperienza utente (ad esempio test A/B, mobile & web)
• Atto come esperto di materia per il prodotto, sostenere i team di business e sviluppo attraverso la condivisione della conoscenza e il mentoring
• Mantenere la consapevolezza delle tendenze del mercato e dell'industria per una migliore ottimizzazione della definizione delle soluzioni
• Fornire indicazioni sulla visione al Team di Sviluppo e spiegare i requisiti
• Creare e mantenere una documentazione completa per i riferimenti delle funzionalità aziendali
• Monitorare i KPI per eseguire la priorità delle funzionalità e migliorare le decisioni basate sui dati
• Assicurare la validazione incrementale del business per assicurarsi che le funzionalità sviluppate soddisfino i requisiti aziendali
• Sfondo educativo: Master o Bachelor
• Hai una profonda comprensione del trading di titoli, forex trading a plus
• Hai diversi anni di esperienza come proprietario del prodotto, analista di affari o un ruolo simile
• Hai diversi anni di esperienza di lavoro con team di sviluppo software agile, e una buona comprensione dello sviluppo del prodotto in un ambiente agile disciplinato
• Hai esperienza di lavorare a stretto contatto con i designer di prodotti per costruire soluzioni client finali su piattaforme web, mobile a plus
• Hai una comprensione approfondita dell'aspetto della qualità del prodotto, con esperienza preventiva di pianificazione e coordinamento delle attività di validazione aziendale
• Sei un eccellente comunicatore e storyteller con diversi stakeholder, in grado di affrontare le parti interessate e clienti istituzionali
• Hai esperienza nella condivisione delle tue conoscenze aziendali e nella mentoring di altri membri del team
• Fluente in inglese

descriptionByLocale.de:
Abteilung Mission - Software Engineering Plattformen Die Abteilung Software Engineering Platforms widmet sich der Customer Journey in Swissquote. Wir definieren, analysieren und machen die Zukunft der kundenorientierten Lösungen von Swissquote lebendig. Wir pflegen auch diese Anwendungen, um immer die beste Kundenerfahrung auf seiner Reise zu gewährleisten. Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Produktstrategieabteilung bilden wir auch die Brücke zwischen der Wachstumsstrategie des Unternehmens und den entsprechenden Lösungen und sind dann die Kernakteure, die die definierte Vision konkretisieren. Durch die Zusammenarbeit mit den internen Abteilungen und dem Unternehmen, das sie vertreten, stellen wir sicher, dass wir uns immer auf die Bedürfnisse von Kunden und Stakeholdern zubewegen. Teammission Der Bereich Institutional and Wealth entwirft, entwickelt und pflegt passive Investmentplattformen im Web und Mobile für Privatkunden (InvestEasy, 3a easy, Save Easy und weitere) sowie das gesamte Lösungspaket für institutionelle Kunden (APIs, SQPro-Plattform, Brücken mit externen FX-Plattformen ...). Sie werden Teil des Institutional and Wealth Conception-Teams sein und mit 3 anderen Produktbesitzern, einem Produktdesigner und einem Offshore-Business-Analysten zusammenarbeiten. Die Mission des Teams ist es, die Unternehmensstrategie in praktikable Lösungen zu verwandeln und gemeinsam mit den Software-Engineering-Teams die Entwicklung des Produkts voranzutreiben. Ihr Team konzentriert sich auf alle Aspekte des institutionellen Geschäfts und des Vermögensmanagements in allen Geschäftsbereichen (Forex, Wertpapiere, Krypto). Ihre Aufgaben:
• Kommunikation und Verwaltung der Beziehungen mit Stakeholdern, um das beste Produkt zu liefern
• Definieren und Dokumentieren von Geschäftsanforderungen, um Geschäftsanforderungen und -beschränkungen zu erfassen und den Entwicklungsprozess zu leiten
• Definieren und pflegen Sie eine Produkt-Roadmap, um den Entwicklungsteams und Stakeholdern eine klare Richtung zu geben
• Priorisieren Sie den Produkt-Backlog, um sicherzustellen, dass die wertvollste Arbeit zuerst angegangen wird und maximieren Sie den ROI
• Analysieren und priorisieren Sie das Kundenfeedback, um kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben und die Erwartungen der Benutzer zu erfüllen
• Arbeiten Sie mit Designern zusammen, um die Benutzererfahrung zu optimieren (z. B. A / B-Tests, Mobile & Web)
• Handeln Sie als Subject Matter Expert für das Produkt, unterstützen Sie Geschäfts- und Entwicklungsteams durch Wissensaustausch und Mentoring
• Bewusstsein für Markt- und Branchentrends für eine bessere Optimierung der Lösungsdefinition

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
You will join the IT Department’s IT Platform Operations team, whose role is to operate the layer between raw infrastructure and the bank’s corporate-facing services: the application-tier middleware fabric, the Kubernetes control plane, and the user-facing surface of the bank’s Sovereign AI Platform.
 The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in operating Kubernetes-native platform engineering systems at scale, and will lead the integration of open-source AI tooling within a regulated corporate environment while ensuring large language model (LLM) inference scales. Your expertise will help your team deliver the platform on which the bank provides governed access to internal and external AI capabilities — distributed inference, agentic workflows, notebooks, and chatbots — built on top of the GPU and serving substrate provided by the Systems & Storage teams.
 With your team, you will work closely with IT Architects, Observability & Performance Analysts, the Cybersecurity function and the Systems teams to plan and execute the department’s long-term objective of a sovereign AI capability that runs under the bank’s own governance — data sovereignty, content safety, prompt-injection defenses, agentic-workflow audit, and cost control on external API spend — and that is AI Act- and DORA-ready by design.

• Design, deploy and operate distributed LLM inference (LLM-d) on Kubernetes — sizing for throughput, tail latency and GPU utilisation against the serving substrate provided by IT Systems Services (ITSS).

• Operate and harden the user-facing AI surface: the Open WebUI cross-department chatbot, JupyterHub notebooks for data scientists, and the agent catalog (agentregistry).

• Build and operate Agentgateway as the governed routing layer to external providers (Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI GPT API), enforcing traffic policy, rate limiting, cost controls and audit logging.

• Implement content-safety, prompt-injection defense and agentic-workflow audit controls, plus the agent-identity model required for EU AI Act and DORA compliance.

• Operate the Kubernetes control plane — etcd, API server, scheduler and controller-manager — with HA sizing and surge-upgrade discipline; contribute to multi-cluster management for the meshed cross-cluster pattern.

• Define SLOs and instrument the platform for performance and availability; lead incident response across the AI platform and control-plane critical path.

• Automate platform provisioning and configuration through Infrastructure as Code and governed automation (AAP), keeping every deployment repeatable, reviewable and auditable.

• Develop and maintain architecture documentation and operational runbooks, and participate in the 24×7 on-call rotation.

Minimum Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering, with at least 3 years operating production Kubernetes and/or machine-learning serving workloads at scale.

• Proven experience managing complex, mission-critical IT environments and contributing to large-scale platform projects.

• Experience in regulated or high-assurance industries such as banking, telco, aviation, pharmaceutics or government.

• Strong understanding of Kubernetes internals, container runtimes, distributed systems, networking and cloud-native security.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, capable of working with multi-functional technical and business teams, along with different levels of management to influence decision making.
 Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with LLM-d or comparable distributed inference / model-serving frameworks (e.g. vLLM, TGI, NVIDIA Triton, Ray Serve, KServe).

• Experience operating JupyterHub, Open WebUI, or similar multi-tenant notebook and chatbot platforms.

• Familiarity with Kubernetes-native agentic frameworks (e.g. kagent), AI traffic-routing / gateway layers (e.g. Agentgateway), and agent-registry / catalog patterns.

• Experience integrating and governing external LLM providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT) — routing, rate limiting, cost control and audit.

• Proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Python, Go, Rust, Java, C++.

• Comfortable with Infrastructure as Code and governed automation tooling (Ansible / AAP, Terraform, etc.); familiarity with event streaming (Apache Kafka) and observability stacks.

SQ2

jobs.title: AI Enablement Engineer

As an AI Enablement Engineer, you will be responsible for accelerating AI adoption across the Technology department while helping the wider organization identify and implement high-impact AI initiatives.
 Reporting directly to the Head Talent & Methodology, you will work closely with Engineering Managers, the Tech Drive (Technical Governance), Communities of Practice, Methodology, Human Resources, Product Strategy, Operational Products, and other business departments.
 Your mission is simple:
 Make AI a core engineering capability at Swissquote.
 You will continuously identify opportunities where AI can improve engineering excellence, operational efficiency, and product innovation, while ensuring adoption follows Swissquote's governance and quality standards.
 Rather than only delivering training, you will build a sustainable enablement ecosystem that allows teams to become autonomous AI practitioners.
 Key Responsibilities
 AI Enablement & Learning

• Design, build and continuously evolve the Software Engineering AI Enablement Program.

• Deliver hands-on workshops, technical trainings, bootcamps and office hours.

• Coordinate AI learning initiatives across Software Engineering and Technology.

• Develop practical learning paths covering Generative AI, AI-assisted software development, prompting, AI agents, automation and emerging AI capabilities.

• Create reusable playbooks, best practices and engineering guidelines.

• Measure AI adoption and continuously improve enablement programs through feedback and metrics.
 Partnership Engineering Excellence

• Work alongside engineering teams to identify opportunities where AI can significantly improve software development lifecycle productivity.

• Help teams integrate AI into software design, coding, testing, documentation, operations and maintenance.

• Prototype AI-powered engineering workflows and reference implementations.

• Actively collaborate with internal Communities of Practice and CoP Manager

• Organize technical talks, demos, hackathons and AI events

• Encourage experimentation while promoting responsible AI usage.
 Working together with the Tech Drive organization, you will:

• Contribute to Software Engineering AI standards and best practices.

• Participate in defining AI governance for engineering activities.

• Ensure AI usage aligns with security, compliance and regulatory requirements.

• Identify recurring engineering challenges and propose AI-driven improvements.
 Business Enablement
 Beyond engineering, you will collaborate with Operational Products, Product Strategy, HR and business stakeholders to:

• Identify high-value AI opportunities.

• Facilitate AI discovery workshops in collaboration with the Methodology Team

• Prototype business solutions using Generative AI.

• Support departments during AI adoption and change management.

• Act as a trusted advisor on AI opportunities and implementation approaches.
 Additional responsibilities - Innovation & External Representation
 As one of Swissquote's AI ambassadors, you will:

• Monitor AI trends, technologies and industry best practices.

• Evaluate emerging AI tools and frameworks.

• Represent Software Engineering internally across Swissquote.

• Contribute to Swissquote's visibility externally through conferences, meetups, articles or technical communities when appropriate.

Required Qualifications

• 2-5 years of experience in Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Developer Experience or Technical Consulting.

• Strong software engineering background with experience building production systems.

• Practical experience using Claude or similar LLMs in your own work: prompt engineering, using AI coding assistants, building small internal tools or scripts that leverage LLM APIs

• Demonstrated experience leading technical enablement, mentoring or training engineers.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong understanding of software engineering best practices.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong bias toward execution and continuous improvement.

• Passion for learning, experimentation and knowledge sharing.

• Curiosity about AI governance, security and cost management, and willingness to learn Swissquote’s specific constraints and policies
 Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Claude Code, OpenWebUI or similar AI development environments.

• Exposure to spec-as-source, agentic workflows, or RAG patterns, even in small side projects

• Prior experience running brown-bag sessions, workshops, or internal documentation initiatives.

• Familiarity with Claude, OpenAI, OpenWebUI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar AI platforms.

• Experience with RAG, AI Agents, MCP, orchestration frameworks or agentic workflows.

• Knowledge of AI governance, security and regulatory requirements.

• Experience working in regulated environments.

• Public speaking experience, conference presentations or technical content creation is a strong plus.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As an AI Enablement Engineer, you will be responsible for accelerating AI adoption across the Technology department while helping the wider organization identify and implement high-impact AI initiatives.
Reporting directly to the Head Talent & Methodology, you will work closely with Engineering Managers, the Tech Drive (Technical Governance), Communities of Practice, Methodology, Human Resources, Product Strategy, Operational Products, and other business departments.
Your mission is simple:
Make AI a core engineering capability at Swissquote.
You will continuously identify opportunities where AI can improve engineering excellence, operational efficiency, and product innovation, while ensuring adoption follows Swissquote's governance and quality standards.
Rather than only delivering training, you will build a sustainable enablement ecosystem that allows teams to become autonomous AI practitioners.
Key Responsibilities
AI Enablement & Learning

• Design, build and continuously evolve the Software Engineering AI Enablement Program.

• Deliver hands-on workshops, technical trainings, bootcamps and office hours.

• Coordinate AI learning initiatives across Software Engineering and Technology.

• Develop practical learning paths covering Generative AI, AI-assisted software development, prompting, AI agents, automation and emerging AI capabilities.

• Create reusable playbooks, best practices and engineering guidelines.

• Measure AI adoption and continuously improve enablement programs through feedback and metrics.
Partnership Engineering Excellence

• Work alongside engineering teams to identify opportunities where AI can significantly improve software development lifecycle productivity.

• Help teams integrate AI into software design, coding, testing, documentation, operations and maintenance.

• Prototype AI-powered engineering workflows and reference implementations.

• Actively collaborate with internal Communities of Practice and CoP Manager

• Organize technical talks, demos, hackathons and AI events

• Encourage experimentation while promoting responsible AI usage.
Working together with the Tech Drive organization, you will:

• Contribute to Software Engineering AI standards and best practices.

• Participate in defining AI governance for engineering activities.

• Ensure AI usage aligns with security, compliance and regulatory requirements.

• Identify recurring engineering challenges and propose AI-driven improvements.
Business Enablement
Beyond engineering, you will collaborate with Operational Products, Product Strategy, HR and business stakeholders to:

• Identify high-value AI opportunities.

• Facilitate AI discovery workshops in collaboration with the Methodology Team

• Prototype business solutions using Generative AI.

• Support departments during AI adoption and change management.

• Act as a trusted advisor on AI opportunities and implementation approaches.
Additional responsibilities - Innovation & External Representation
As one of Swissquote's AI ambassadors, you will:

• Monitor AI trends, technologies and industry best practices.

• Evaluate emerging AI tools and frameworks.

• Represent Software Engineering internally across Swissquote.

• Contribute to Swissquote's visibility externally through conferences, meetups, articles or technical communities when appropriate.

Required Qualifications

• 2-5 years of experience in Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Developer Experience or Technical Consulting.

• Strong software engineering background with experience building production systems.

• Practical experience using Claude or similar LLMs in your own work: prompt engineering, using AI coding assistants, building small internal tools or scripts that leverage LLM APIs

• Demonstrated experience leading technical enablement, mentoring or training engineers.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong understanding of software engineering best practices.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong bias toward execution and continuous improvement.

• Passion for learning, experimentation and knowledge sharing.

• Curiosity about AI governance, security and cost management, and willingness to learn Swissquote’s specific constraints and policies
Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Claude Code, OpenWebUI or similar AI development environments.

• Exposure to spec-as-source, agentic workflows, or RAG patterns, even in small side projects

• Prior experience running brown-bag sessions, workshops, or internal documentation initiatives.

• Familiarity with Claude, OpenAI, OpenWebUI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar AI platforms.

• Experience with RAG, AI Agents, MCP, orchestration frameworks or agentic workflows.

• Knowledge of AI governance, security and regulatory requirements.

• Experience working in regulated environments.

• Public speaking experience, conference presentations or technical content creation is a strong plus.

jobs.description:
As an Associate-Director in the FX & DA Trading department, you will be in charge of the eFX Spot team. Reporting directly to the Head Spot Vice-Director, you will supervise the operational activities and manage people in accordance with your senior management.
 Key responsibilities
 Team Management:

• Leading and supporting the eFX Spot team:
• Fostering a positive work atmosphere where employees feel motivated, valued, and connected to the team and the organization.

• Promoting collaboration, trust, and cohesion among team members.

• Addressing any potential conflicts among team members to your senior management and/or HR Partner

• Supporting employee growth through training, mentorship, coaching, and advancement opportunities.

• Hiring:
• Leading the recruitment process with your Talent Acquisition Partner

• Ensuring new hires are properly introduced to the team, the organization, its culture, policies, and their specific roles.

• Performance Management: Setting performance expectations, providing feedback, conducting performance reviews, and addressing any performance issues.

• Conducting under performance process with the help of your Senior Management and HR Partner.
 Operational duties:

• Own the realized risk and PnL

• Ensure successful and compliant operations
• Monitor orders, trades, overall market conditions, news flow, real-time risk and PnL

• Fine-tune price construction, execution and risk management production systems

• Monitor the overall client activity and ensure flow quality, as well as smooth client trading experience

• Maintain a gainful network of hedging counterparties and market venues

• Analyze results, identify and drive improvements

• Data analysis: Use internal analytical tools and your own quantitative capabilities to draw data-driven conclusions, suggest actions, deliver reporting

• Documentation: maintain up-to-date operational procedures and ensure compliance

• Collaborating: Be a reference point for Sales, Software Engineers, IT colleagues and other internal teams

• Project Management: Contribute to product development and infrastructure improvements

• Monitoring: team’s capacity allocation

• Minimum 8 years’ experience in sell-side electronic FX trading

• Previous experience in a leadership role is a strong advantage

• Deep understanding of market (micro)structure

• Deep understanding of client needs (both retail and institutional segments) and the competition landscape

• Proficient in transforming large data sets into actionable insights

• Ability to prioritize and deliver multiple tasks in a deadline-driven environment

• Excellent interpersonal skills, results-oriented, team player

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

As a Senior information Security Engineer, you will play a key role in building security and privacy by design in our information systems and products.

You will be responsible to identify and analyze new risks and vulnerabilities, and to design effective remediation to improve our security posture. You will also contribute to the software engineers security training, fostering a culture of security consciousness among employees and stakeholders.
 Together with the other members of the IT Security team, you will contribute to make our Bank more secure and resilient, and to grow efficiently in an increasingly regulated industry.

• Provide security advisory and guidelines to software engineering teams to elaborate, enforce and monitor security controls and solutions.
